title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：motion　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 motion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the researcher ① started the motion that no student in the lab would have measured, and he said the starting was the whole of the term. The ② motion, meaning the move itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unmeasured in the book; a motion, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ motion in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ motion at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A motion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the researcher said the measuring is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the motion was the whole of the matter, meaning the change and not the move. The ⑥ motion, meaning the change and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; motion, he said, is either something you start or the only word that means both a move and a change. He said the change is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ motion had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ motion of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of measuring; motion, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ motion I remember is the move measured in the paper, which closed in 1981 and is still measured as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ motion, my mother said in 1983, is the only move that improves by being measured; every motion, she said, is a change that has agreed to look like a move. She said the change was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 运动；移动（指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 运动；移动（指那个运动本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：start the motion 启动这一个运动
D. n. 运动；移动（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 运动之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的运动之事）
F. n. 运动；移动（指研究报告里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 运动、变动（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 变动（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: started the motion that no student in the lab would have measured
The motion, meaning the move itself and not the tube
the motion at the far bench
the motion was the whole of the matter

The motion of the whole thing

answers.why: start the motion 意为“启动这一个运动”，1974 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯测量的一个运动做了一遍。
motion 意为“运动；移动”，指那个运动本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被测量。
motion 意为“运动；移动”，指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
motion 意为“运动；移动”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
motion 意为“运动、变动”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个变动就是那件事的全部。
motion 意为“变动”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个运动，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
motion 意为“运动；移动”，指研究报告里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1979 年这一个成了研究报告里的一行。
motion 意为“运动之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的运动之事是一处实验室和三个学期的测量。
motion 意为“运动；移动”，我记得的是研究报告里测量过的那一个，1981 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一个。
motion 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，运动是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的运动。
